actual_publish_bar.endpoint: systems/graph/publications.json must name document existing at candidate SHA and a falsifiable what_it_would_claim at least40 characters. Endpoint lookup itself reads working-tree graph; keep it aligned with candidate.

actual_publish_bar.readability: Registered manuscript must pass sentence ceiling and caution safeguards AND editorial_readability.verify_review. Add canonical source and all outgoing supplementary prose to editorial-prose-inventory.json; commit readability-reviews/PUB-ID.json schema emc-llm-readability-review/1, actual independent reader/report identity and hashes, writer_ids, timezone timestamp, all checks, question/approach/finding/limits/next-step explanation, no blockers. Artifact/report bytes must match at candidate SHA.

This clause checks registration/import only, not successful render or visual inspection; separately build, compare outgoing text to reviewed source and inspect render per readability contract.

reusable.full_preflight_reuse_rule: Clause2 requires exact candidate SHA, unlike review digest equivalence. Do not use another SHA's full receipt or merely a successful targeted Foundation job.

commands.note: Templates only. Run on suitable Linux/CI capacity with complete source scope. No command below executed here.
commands.full_gate_bash:
candidate_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
printf 'PINNED_SHA=%s\n' "$candidate_sha" > /tmp/foundation-preflight-full.log
set +e
PREFLIGHT_FULL=1 ./scripts/preflight.sh >> /tmp/foundation-preflight-full.log 2>&1
preflight_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'EXIT=%s\n' "$preflight_rc" >> /tmp/foundation-preflight-full.log
python3 research/autonomy/record_bar_evidence.py preflight --sha "$candidate_sha" --log /tmp/foundation-preflight-full.log
commands.interpretation: Journal command returns nonzero even with all clauses passing because journal authority always refuses. Report clause results separately from authority/may_post. Do not change venue flag to manufacture journal permission.
commands.receipt_sequence: Freeze content candidate SHA before full run. Root later commits derived receipt/log and review records without moving the intended publication content pin; evaluate original candidate with these supporting records available. If outgoing content changes, identify affected checks. Do not loop by reclassifying every receipt-only commit as new content candidate.

Do not dispatch unchanged under root-sole-writer/no-main-write scope. Full integration/publication checks retain full scope; do not sparse away source/tests, set SKIP_TESTS=1 with FULL, reduce baseline, edit gate logic or alter criteria to force green.
